description: This file contains the implementation of the WSEndpoint class template for WebSocket server/client endpoints, including methods for connection management, message handling, event loop control, and registration of handlers. It also explicitly instantiates the template for various configurations.

classes.name: WSEndpoint
classes.description: A template class implementing WebSocket endpoint functionality, including connection management, message handling, event loop control, and handler registration, parameterized by role, messaging interface, ping-pong, and encryption strategies.

methods.name: WSEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WebSocket endpoint, setting up logging, handlers, and encryption.

methods.name: ~WSEndpoint
methods.description: Destructor stopping the event loop and closing connections.

methods.name: closeConnection
methods.description: Closes the current WebSocket connection if it is open.

methods.name: startEventLoop
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket event loop in a separate thread.

methods.name: stopEventLoop
methods.description: Stops the WebSocket event loop thread if running.

methods.name: registerHandlers
methods.description: Registers message, open, close, and fail handlers for WebSocket events.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, filtering by opcode.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the connection object from a handler.
